messages:
Ava: RFC follow-up: proposing an "anchor federation" idea — anchors own capability state (kv, session-index, prefix-cache) but can be federated for read-scaling. small shim (stitch adapter) exposes a tiny contract. goal: reduce cross-team coupling and make refactors reversible. feedback?

Diego: sounds promising. federation adds complexity; main asks: how do we keep hotpath latency stable?

Ava: two-path adapter model: 1) inline shim (library) -> direct in-process call when colocated, 2) federated RPC path for remote anchors with smart client-side cache. client chooses based on policy.

Priya: migration strategy? we can't afford big-bang.

Ava: shadowing first: run writes to anchor + legacy store in parallel (non-blocking). reads default to legacy until samples validate parity. then staged read-traffic handoff: sample 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%. reconciliation job repairs drift.

Nora: on schema churn: add stable metadata envelope: {anchor_version, schema_level, key_meta}. adapters must tolerate unknown fields and honor schema_level header. Breaking changes require a flagged migration window.

InfraBot: Created ticket infra#4367  anchor-federation spike + perf harness.

Diego: observability: we need golden signals per anchor: p95 latency, error-rate, divergence-sample, reconciliation-rate. traces must include anchor_hint and adapter_mode.

Priya: fallback behavior? If anchor latency spikes, client should fallback to legacy path immediately. need circuit-breaker + TTL-based warm fallback.

Ava: agreed. example config snippet: 
```
adapter.cfg = {
  mode_priority: ["inline","federated","legacy"],
  circuit: {error_threshold:0.02, cool_off_s:30},
  canary_steps: [0.1,1,10,100]
}
```

Nora: who owns anchors operationally? Each anchor must have an owner team, runbook, and a minimal SLA. propose a registry with owner/contact + runbook link.

Ava: product + infra will curate the registry. owners must provide runbook and emergency rollback steps before accepting traffic.

Priya: testing: I'll build a shadow harness that injects TTL churn and key hot-spotting. want a perf baseline for inline vs federated.

Diego: add a small compatibility toolkit that can automap keys with prefixes like v2:... and tombstones for deletes. makes rollbacks easier.

InfraBot: Linked docs: https://go/repo/anchors and infra#4367. Perf job perf/anchor-federation-smoke queued.

Ava: action items: @Priya shadow harness (Weds), @Diego compatibility toolkit (EOW), @Nora owner registry proto + dashboard template (Fri). I'll draft the RFC follow-up with the minimal contract, handoff plan, and rollback checklist. aim: incremental, observable, reversible. :seedling:
